say:3:1029762001:1.text: Adamant Syndicate?! Are you behind all this?!
say:3:1029762001:1.source_cn: 居然是黑金商会的家伙！你们就是幕后黑手吗？！

say:4:1029762002:1.text: Spill it! What's the Syndicate planning to do to Rowan... to the Mithril Consortium?!
say:4:1029762002:1.source_cn: 说！黑金商会想对罗万……不，想对秘银商会做什么！

say:5:1029762003:0.text: Whoa! Don't get it wrong! It's just business, we're just trying to make a living.
say:5:1029762003:0.source_cn: 哎呀，别误会，别误会！大家都是出来打工的，不要赶尽杀绝！

say:6:1029762004:1.text: Trying to make a living?! Wait—you mean someone hired you?
say:6:1029762004:1.source_cn: 打工？！你是说，你也是接受委托的吗？

say:7:1029762005:1.text: Of course. The Adamant Syndicate is all about friendly, fair trade. We'd never go after the heir to the Mithril Consortium... at least, not officially.
say:7:1029762005:1.source_cn: 是啊，我们黑金商会向来与人为善，主张平等友好的贸易关系...

choice_prompt:8:1029762005.text: Of course. The Adamant Syndicate is all about friendly, fair trade. We'd never go after the heir to the Mithril Consortium... at least, not officially.
choice_prompt:8:1029762005.source_cn: 是啊，我们黑金商会向来与人为善，主张平等友好的贸易关系，怎么可能对秘银商会的继承人公然动手……

say:9:1029762006:1.text: Okay, okay—this was off the books! A side hustle. A personal favor, that's all. The Syndicate didn't authorize this, I swear!
say:9:1029762006:1.source_cn: 但我是私下接活，私人委托，私人关系，真的不能代表商会啊！

say:10:1029762008:1.text: *Sigh* Business is hard these days. I've gotta keep my big clients happy somehow.
say:10:1029762008:1.source_cn: 唉，如今哪里工作都不好做，我也是为了维护我的大客户嘛。

say:13:1029762009:1.text: Your big client? You mean the one who hired you?
say:13:1029762009:1.source_cn: 你的大客户？你是说，委托你对我动手的那个人？

say:14:1029762010:0.text: 是的，你也知道吧，就是</style>与<style="highlight">平德</style>，这一带的区域负责人。

say:15:1029762011:1.text: Pinder... I see. So it was him.

say:16:1029762012:0.text: Rowan, is that the one on your suspect list?
say:16:1029762012:0.source_cn: 是你之前怀疑的人吗，罗万？

say:17:1029762013:0.text: Yeah. The list of suspects wasn't long, and he was near the top. I can't say I'm surprised.
say:17:1029762013:0.source_cn: 嗯，本来怀疑名单就不算很长，他在其中又算是名列前茅，所...

say:19:1029762014:0.text: Alright then, keep going. What's your connection to Pinder?
say:19:1029762014:0.source_cn: 好了，你继续说吧，平德跟你们是什么关系？

say:20:1029762015:0.text: Connection? Just normal business dealings. Nothing shady... okay, maybe there's a little give and take.
say:20:1029762015:0.source_cn: 关系……就是正常的商务往来关系，没有任何别的……呃，可...

say:21:1029762016:1.text: He's a major client I worked hard to land. Made things easy for me, so I try to return the favor...
say:21:1029762016:1.source_cn: 他可是我好不容易拿下的大客户，给了不少方便，那我肯定也...

say:22:1029762017:1.text: So the favor was... to attack me? What exactly did he say?
say:22:1029762017:1.source_cn: 所以，他这次委托你来袭击我？具体是怎么说的？

say:23:1029762018:1.text: He said the naive young master was digging through the accounts and messing with the loyal old guards.
say:23:1029762018:1.source_cn: 这次他说，秘银商会乳臭未干的小少爷自以为是地查账，想对...

say:24:1029762019:1.text: If the young master gets his way, my partnership with him is as good as over...
say:24:1029762019:1.source_cn: 如果让这小子得逞，那以后我们的合作就全盘泡汤了……

say:25:1029762020:1.text: So I used the Syndicate's network to keep an eye on you once you left Holistone...
say:25:1029762020:1.source_cn: 所以我也用了黑金商会这边的渠道，留意了你从圣石镇离开以...

say:26:1029762021:1.text: You hired someone else for the job back then?

say:27:1029762022:1.text: Naturally. People who take on side jobs always outsource to keep a low profile.
say:27:1029762022:1.source_cn: 那当然，我们做私活的人怎么能那么嚣张，肯定是花点钱转包...

say:28:1029762023:1.text: It's just that... the results weren't great. Pinder got antsy and pushed me to do it myself, so I... yeah.
say:28:1029762023:1.source_cn: 只是效果不尽如人意，平德那边着急，催我动手，我就……唉。

choice_prompt:29:1029762023.text: It's just that... the results weren't great. Pinder got antsy and pushed me to do it myself, so I... yeah.
choice_prompt:29:1029762023.source_cn: 只是效果不尽如人意，平德那边着急，催我动手，我就……唉。

say:30:1029762024:1.text: Well, the dirt you've got on me is way worse than anything Pinder has. I know which way the wind's blowing—I mean... it's time for me to do the right thing!
say:30:1029762024:1.source_cn: 那当然，在你们手里的把柄比我在平德手里的要大得多，我肯...

say:31:1029762025:1.text: You all work for yourselves. Me? I'm just a contractor.
say:31:1029762025:1.source_cn: 罗万少爷以及诸位姑且还是为自家赚钱，我可就是个打工的。

say:32:1029762026:1.text: So please, since I've been so cooperative, could you maybe not report this to the Syndicate?
say:32:1029762026:1.source_cn: 各位，看在我配合的份上，能不能不要通报我们黑金商会？

say:34:1029762028:1.text: Don't worry! If you agree, I'll hand over all the records of dealings between me and Pinder.
say:34:1029762028:1.source_cn: 您放心，只要您答应，我回去立刻把和平德有利益输送的账目...

say:35:1029762029:1.text: And I'll request a transfer to another area. I swear you won't see me here again—
say:35:1029762029:1.source_cn: 并且跟上头申请调令，去别的片区，绝对不会在这碍诸位的眼——

choice_prompt:36:1029762029.text: And I'll request a transfer to another area. I swear you won't see me here again—
choice_prompt:36:1029762029.source_cn: 并且跟上头申请调令，去别的片区，绝对不会在这碍诸位的眼——

say:37:1029762030:1.text: That's my world. You're either quick to adapt, or you're out. Not that some high-and-mighty Magister would ever get it.
say:37:1029762030:1.source_cn: 出门做生意也好打工也罢，这可是必须的，尊贵的魔法师大人...
say:37:1029762030:1.male: That's my world. You're either quick to adapt, or you're out. Not that some high-and-mighty Magister would ever get it.
say:37:1029762030:1.female: That's my world. You're either quick to adapt, or you're out. Not that some high-and-mighty Magister would ever get it.

say:38:1029762032:0.text: Well, I'm not hurt, and even if I turn you in, the Syndicate would probably just issue a half-baked apology and pay compensation.
say:38:1029762032:0.source_cn: 也好，反正我也没受伤，就算把你交给黑金商会，估计也就是...

say:39:1029762033:1.text: I'll hold on to the evidence. When the time comes, we'll trade. If you hold up your end, I'll let you off the hook.
say:39:1029762033:1.source_cn: 我会存留证据，到时我们彼此交换，如果你能做到你许诺的，...

say:40:1029762034:1.text: Thank you! Really, thank you! I promise—I'll be in touch soon!
say:40:1029762034:1.source_cn: 万分感谢您的宽容！请相信我的信誉，我会尽快联络您！

say:41:1029762035:0.text: After giving you a time and contact for the handoff, the Syndicate member bows repeatedly and hurries off.
say:41:1029762035:0.source_cn: 黑金商会的跟踪者在留下联系方式和交接时间后，千恩万谢地...

say:44:1029762036:1.text: Uh, I didn't even get a chance to speak up just now... Rowan, there's a traitor who hired outside help to go after you?
say:44:1029762036:1.source_cn: 呃，我刚刚都没敢插嘴……所以，罗万，你是遇到叛徒了，请...

say:45:1029762037:0.text: More or less. We've been attacked a few times, and I thought it was someone serious.
say:45:1029762037:0.source_cn: 差不多是这么回事吧，之前我们被袭击了几次，我还以为是个...

say:46:1029762038:1.text: But now that we know who and how they operate, it's actually less worrying.
say:46:1029762038:1.source_cn: 但现在既然确定了他的身份和行动方式，就反而不需要太担心了。

say:47:1029762039:1.text: Because the girl you just let go won't act again?
say:47:1029762039:1.source_cn: 是因为刚刚被你放走的，这个负责执行的家伙已经不会再动手了吗？

say:48:1029762040:1.text: Right. Pinder's great with numbers and managing things, but without people on the ground, he's stuck.
say:48:1029762040:1.source_cn: 是的，平德做账和管理都是把好手，但纯粹的管理者要是少了...

say:49:1029762041:1.text: And this Syndicate lady? She wasn't just boots on the ground—she was also his eyes and ears.
say:49:1029762041:1.source_cn: 更何况这位黑金商会的女士不止是手脚，更是耳目。

choice_prompt:50:1029762041.text: And this Syndicate lady? She wasn't just boots on the ground—she was also his eyes and ears.
choice_prompt:50:1029762041.source_cn: 更何况这位黑金商会的女士不止是手脚，更是耳目。

say:51:1029762042:1.text: Exactly. Now that we know where the attacks are coming from, we can focus on moving forward with our plans.
say:51:1029762042:1.source_cn: 是，知道了他出招的方向后，就可以有条不紊地推进我们自己...

say:52:1029762044:1.text: So the top priority now is to push ahead with building the new trade route. We can't let Pinder keep slowing us down.
say:52:1029762044:1.source_cn: 所以，目前最重要的事，还是先推进新商路的建设，不能继续...

say:53:1029762045:1.text: Then I'll get started gathering supplies—I've already decided! We're buying up the local wheat and all the goods made from it.
say:53:1029762045:1.source_cn: 那我就在这里尽快采购些货物——我已经想好了，就是这儿的...

say:54:1029762046:1.text: Flour, bread, pastries, tea... and of course, can't forget the wheat brew!
say:54:1029762046:1.source_cn: 面粉、面包、点心，茶……当然最少不了的就是麦酒！

say:55:1029762047:1.text: Just the smell of it tells me—there's no way the folks in Brimstone Village can resist!
say:55:1029762047:1.source_cn: 光闻这个香味，我就知道，深岩村里那帮人绝对抵挡不了！

say:56:1029762048:0.text: As you excitedly discuss what goods to buy, you notice a faint gleam of light flicker from within your bag...
say:56:1029762048:0.source_cn: 正在你们热火朝天地讨论货物的选择时，你注意到，包裹里闪...
say:56:1029762048:0.male: As you excitedly discuss what goods to buy, you notice a faint gleam of light flicker from within your bag...
say:56:1029762048:0.female: As you excitedly discuss what goods to buy, you notice a faint gleam of light flicker from within your bag...

say:60:1029762050:1.text: It's almost glowing now... So pretty!
say:60:1029762050:1.source_cn: 这次几乎已经全亮了……好漂亮啊！

say:61:1029762051:1.text: Hmm, but what triggered it this time...?
say:61:1029762051:1.source_cn: 唔，但这次又是因为什么才会亮呢……

choice_prompt:62:1029762051.text: Hmm, but what triggered it this time...?
choice_prompt:62:1029762051.source_cn: 唔，但这次又是因为什么才会亮呢……

say:63:1029762052:0.text: Thinking back to when you first arrived there? Heh, it wasn't even that long ago!
say:63:1029762052:0.source_cn: 是因为想起来刚到深岩村时的那些事了吗？哈哈，那可没过去多久！

say:64:1029762054:1.text: With the scent of wheat in the air, even tough memories start to feel soft and warm...
say:64:1029762054:1.source_cn: 伴着这里的麦香，无论是怎样的回忆，都好像变得温柔起来了呢……

say:65:1029762055:1.text: Just one last piece to light up on this bookmark... What should we do?
say:65:1029762055:1.source_cn: 这书签就差一点点就全部点亮了……最后的这一点，要怎样才...

choice_prompt:66:1029762055.text: Just one last piece to light up on this bookmark... What should we do?
choice_prompt:66:1029762055.source_cn: 这书签就差一点点就全部点亮了……最后的这一点，要怎样才能恢复呢？

say:67:1029762056:1.text: Right. Memories take time and experience to build.
say:67:1029762056:1.source_cn: 说的也是，回忆是需要体验和时间才能创造的嘛！

say:68:1029762057:1.text: Anyway, let's get back on track and prep the trade route between the two places.
say:68:1029762057:1.source_cn: 那我们还是回到正题，尽快准备两地的通商吧？

say:70:1029762058:0.text: Right. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go fix up the trade station.
say:70:1029762058:0.male: Right. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go fix up the trade station.
say:70:1029762058:0.female: Right. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go fix up the trade station.

say:71:1029762059:1.text: Then finalize things with Brimstone Village. <style="highlight">Trade</style> between it and Holistone can officially begin!
say:71:1029762059:1.source_cn: 接着和深岩村那边确认，圣石镇和深岩村之间就可以进行<s...

choice:62:0:1.text: Our time in the Brimstone Village.
choice:62:0:1.male: Our time in the Brimstone Village.
choice:62:0:1.female: Our time in the Brimstone Village.

say:73:1029762053:0.text: Yeah, we teamed up on that investigation back then...
say:73:1029762053:0.source_cn: 嗯，当时我们也在这里一同调查，并肩作战过……

say:74:1029762043:1.text: Of course. But now that we've seen his hand, defense becomes a lot easier.
say:74:1029762043:1.source_cn: 当然不会，只是在知道了他的出击方式后，防守就变得相当轻松了。

choice:50:1:2.text: We still need to stay sharp.
choice:50:1:2.male: We still need to stay sharp.
choice:50:1:2.female: We still need to stay sharp.

say:75:1029762031:1.text: You know it. Always looking for the best deal.
say:75:1029762031:1.source_cn: 我们做生意的最重要的就是眼光和判断力嘛。

say:76:1029762007:0.text: No! If it's the Syndicate, it wouldn't be this sloppy—uh, I mean, again, this is just a side job I took!
say:76:1029762007:0.source_cn: 没错，要是商会动手，怎么会这么粗糙……我是说，这是我的...
